conclusion: No blocker found in initial 414-LP comparison; improve failure reporting before reusing benchmark.
implemented: Validate supported/unsupported result states against retained production records.
Separate unsupported, failed and executed-but-inconclusive rows in summaries.
Record health counts, Python/NumPy/SciPy/COBRApy versions and fail execution exit status on unsuccessful cases.
Register observation hash without exposing labels to planning or simulation.
Eight additional fault-injection tests; real-model oracle remains separate.
Two no-sulfur controls validate sulfur restriction.
clarifications: Evaluation remains available after failures; it explicitly reports incomplete execution and requires a separate oracle report for acceptance.
Do not hardcode 216 supported cases in general runner; the frozen archive verifier checks all expected case counts.
Existing independent oracle checks numerical solution and GPR knockout, not scientific correctness of supplied chemical/gene mapping.
Source receipts protect against accidental mismatch; they are not cryptographic attestations from an external authority.
